title: Thermal Simulation
subtitle: Understand the thermal challenge before committing to hardware.
description: In-house thermal analysis supports evaluation of heat transfer, temperature distribution, coolant strategy and system behaviour throughout development.
alt: Thermal simulation mesh and CFD velocity distribution

title: In-House Design
subtitle: Design that understands how it will be built.
description: Engineering and design are connected directly with manufacturing so thermal performance, geometry, manufacturability and assembly can be considered together.
alt: In-house CAD engineering and thermal design workstation

title: Friction Stir Welding
subtitle: High-integrity joining without melting the base material.
description: In-house friction stir welding enables solid-state joining for aluminium and copper liquid-cooling assemblies with complex internal channels.
alt: FSW spindle joining liquid cold plate channel plates

title: 5-Axis CNC Milling
subtitle: Complex geometry. Controlled precision.
description: In-house machining supports complex aluminium components and thermal-management hardware from prototype development through production.
alt: 5-Axis CNC milling machine fabricating cooling fluid channels

title: Embedded Heat-Sink Manufacturing
subtitle: Controlled force. Integrated assemblies.
description: An in-house hydraulic press supports controlled manufacturing steps for embedded heat-sink and thermal assemblies, keeping critical alignment and assembly close to the engineering team.
alt: Hydraulic press integrating heat pipes into heat sink base

title: In-House Quality Team
subtitle: Quality is part of the process.
description: A dedicated in-house quality team supports inspection and verification throughout manufacturing against defined engineering and customer requirements.

title: ISO 9001:2015 Certified
subtitle: A structured system for controlled manufacturing.
description: ITS operates under an ISO 9001:2015 certified Quality Management System supporting consistent quality, customer focus and continuous improvement.
